issues.legal_issue: The power to grant a lease regularising an old grant is discretionary, and a refusal to grant such a lease must rest on sufficient reasons in a suitable case.
material_facts: The applicants held a site on old-grant terms without a regular lease and applied to have their rights regularised by a lease.
The authorities refused to issue the requested lease, and the applicants sought a direction compelling its issue.
The governing rule used the word “may” and made the proposed lease subject to approval by the Central Government or an authority appointed by it.
The High Court directed the authorities to reconsider the application in accordance with law, and the appeal challenged the denial of a direction to issue the lease.
issues.conclusion: The applicants were not entitled to a direction requiring the lease to be issued. The grant was discretionary, but refusal was appropriate only in a suitable case where sufficient reasons existed; the application therefore had to be reconsidered under that standard.
issues.legal_principle: Under Rule 27 of the Cantonment Land Administration Rules, 1937, the word “may” ordinarily confers discretion, particularly where the proposed action is also subject to approval by another authority capable of disapproving it. The court distinguished Sardar Govindrao v. State of Madhya Pradesh, [1965] 1 S.C.R. 678: although “may” can mean “shall” or “must” where the context makes exercise of the power a duty, the general power and approval requirement in Rule 27 showed no such duty to grant a lease in every case.

rule.if: appeal_seeks_mandatory_lease_for_old_grant and site_lacks_regular_lease and lease_power_is_discretionary and higher_authority_approval_is_required

predicates.appeal_seeks_mandatory_lease_for_old_gra: The proceeding is an appeal seeking to compel the grant of a lease to regularise an old grant.
predicates.site_lacks_regular_lease: The holder occupies a site under an old grant without a regular lease.
predicates.lease_power_is_discretionary: The governing arrangement gives the grantor discretion over whether to issue the lease.
predicates.higher_authority_approval_is_required: The proposed lease is subject to approval by a higher authority.

issues.definition: When an appeal seeks to compel a lease for a site held without a regular lease and the grant is discretionary and requires higher-authority approval, the grant is not automatic and refusal requires sufficient reasons in a suitable case.
